version.approval_notes:
The attached source archive is this repository at the submitted version's commit.

To rebuild the submitted package on Linux or macOS with Node.js 20 (see .nvmrc) and the zip and unzip tools:

  npm ci
  npm run package:firefox

The add-on is the dist/firefox directory. scripts/build-firefox.js lists every Firefox-specific manifest change.

Generated and third-party code:
- src/react/*.js is built by Vite from react-src/ (npm run build:react, which package:firefox runs first).
- assets/vendor/pinyin-pro.js is pinyin-pro 3.28.0, unmodified: https://unpkg.com/pinyin-pro@3.28.0/dist/index.js

Every other file ships as written.
